name: lounge-deploy
description: Build and validate static Lounge upload ZIPs locally, with optional score/ranking SDK integration for games.

interface.shortDescription: Build, validate, and rank-ready Lounge game ZIPs
interface.longDescription: Analyze a single HTML, static web, Vite, or Next.js project; make only the minimum static-export changes; build and inspect the output locally; and use the current Let's Coding policy for final manifest validation and a Korean completion report. For score-based games, it can add the Lounge ranking SDK only when requested. Source files, ZIP bytes, environment values, and credentials are not sent to the MCP server. Actual Lounge upload is not included.
